tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Keyword search over minairal.com: system pages, guides, FAQ answers, sector and location pages, and published blog articles. Returns up to 8 results with title, URL and snippet.

tools.name: get_contact_options

Read-only: it does not send anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_locations, search_content, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_facts, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options · Destructive: recommend_system.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_locations, search_content, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_facts, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options · Destructive: recommend_system

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
